description: This Java class 'ViewFactory' is responsible for loading and managing view handlers based on configuration, providing access to specific view handlers by type, and ensuring a default handler is available.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing view handlers, loading them from configuration, and providing access based on type.

methods.name: ViewFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes view handlers from configuration URL, setting up default if necessary.

methods.name: getViewHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a view handler by type, defaults to 'default' if type is empty, throws exception if not found.
